d: Alakshendr apni vishal sena ke sath bharat ki or barh raha hai, vah anek chhote bare pradeshon par hamla karta huaa aage ki or barh raha hai. vishnugupt ko dar hai yadi use roka nahin gaya to vah sampurn bharat par apna aadhipaty sthapit kar lega aur phir akhand bharat ko tutne se koee nahin bacha sakta. vishnugupt isi aas men magadh naresh dhannand ke pas aate hain aur phir jo hota hai uska sakshi itihas hai .....! kya hota hai aage dekhie is bhag men.
